reviews.text: Dr. McConaughey is very caring and truly seems concerned about your furry babies. I love the staff, as well, because they always treat you like a friend instead of a customer! I highly recommend VCA Springbranch!
Five stars made our day! 🐾💙 Thank you for trusting our team with your pet’s care. We truly appreciate you being part of the VCA family. …

My pets have been coming here since 3 months old and have always had top quality service. Recently i took them to be groomed on a weekday and after picking them up found out that one of my boxers had a bad rash and ear infection. i called Spring Branch in a panic wirried about my dog and without an appointment htye told me to bring them in. When i got there they took them right in to se their Dr, Dr Grana. She assessed him and gave me the medicine he needed. He is back to being his happy energetic self. Thank Guys
ALWAYS take great care of my fuzzy kids!

Great service, and communication. I love how they don’t stop the service after I leave the hospital. They always make sure to check up on my pet a few days after the visit. So far I had a great experience working with VCA, highly recommend. Great staff and Dr. Clemmenson has taken the best care of my pet!
Been going to this place for a year and a half. Staff is very friendly and good with my cat :))

I am extremely disappointed with how VCA Animal Hospital - Spring Branch has handled a billing issue involving a disconnect between the VCA Hospital and VCA CareClub.

I was sent to collections for a bill that I should not have been responsible for because the service was covered under my plan. This issue has now gone unresolved for more than a year and a half, despite numerous phone calls and repeated assurances from hospital staff that it had been taken care of.

Unfortunately, it was not taken care of. The account went to collections and ultimately caused my credit score to drop by approximately 30 points.

What has been most frustrating is the lack of accountability and follow-through. I was told VCA Care Club would waive the charge "as a courtesy," but this was not a courtesy issue. I should not have been charged in the first place. The claim was not handled appropriately, and there was also a significant breakdown in communication from the business office. I repeatedly followed up and relied on VCA's assurances that the matter had been resolved.

After more than a year and a half, I am still dealing with the consequences of an issue I did not create.

The doctor has always been very sweet, and I have had positive experiences with the clinical staff, which makes this situation even more disappointing. Unfortunately, the billing experience, lack of communication, and impact on my credit have damaged my trust in VCA, and I will be moving my pet's care to another location.

I hope VCA takes this seriously--not simply by removing the charge, but by correcting the collections reporting and addressing the damage this has caused to my credit. I was assured, again, that this will be resolved within a month. Let's hope this credible.
The people and vets are great. So helpful
I'm trying to get in touch but they never answer the phone 😡 …

I have been going here for six years and they always take good care of my dog. These doctors are very knowledgeable and are always available if you need help; my dog had a bad infection and they treated him right away. Super grateful !

I am so grateful for the techs giving my cat the choice to participate during the entire appointment. The appointment started when she chose to leave the carrier, and no one manhandled her unnecessarily or picked her up without her approaching first. Everyone was very kind and informative. Phenomenal staff all around.
Great care all around for my pet. My dog and I felt very comfortable. Transparent.
Excellent service
Got my bun spayed here, for 650. They do provide all materials necessary for aftercare. They are sweet and straightforward, vet here cares.

Rude over the phone. Also don’t fall for the VCA scam they offer you. If you fell for it just know it auto renews and they don’t tell you. Cannot trust someone who tries to scam you. There’s a vet down gessner that is way better and has better prices and you don’t have to deal with know it all attitudes. Yuck!

Avoid this place as much as possible if you’re new!! This is a 0 star place. I came in for their advertised complimentary 1st wellness exam. My appointment is scheduled for 4:20pm and I arrived at 4:25pm. Only 5 minutes mind you because of built up traffic of Gessner Rd. I gather my items and get my puppy out of the car. Mind you, I have a TFCC tear on my wrist and a nerve injury on my foot, so I’m not as fast as I can be. I park right in front of their doors in the handicap parking. I walk in and let the front desk girl know what I’m here for. She says okay and looks at the time that just turned to 4:31. She tells me I can’t be seen anymore because it’s ONE MINUTE over their apparent 10 minute grace period. She insists that it’s protocol, not policy, even though my confirmation email says NOTHING about said protocol. I’ve received calls from them before and was never informed of that at ANY location. I ask if they can be courteous enough to still see me and explained the whole arrival process for me. She gets with an attitude instantly and notifies me that I can be seen within 10-15 minutes. I say okay and she then tells me that it would be under Urgent Care and I would need to pay $144. Excuse me?? That’s absurd to have to pay that for an extra minute for a protocol that was never communicated or posted anywhere. And she then proceeds to tell me “it’s either paying the $144 or not being seen at all today”. This girl knows nothing about what a day it’s been for me at all to then be rude and disrespectful to me in the manner that she was. If you don’t know how to give basic customer service or just be a human being with simple etiquette, then just stay home. If that’s how they treat me without even officially starting my appointment, can you imagine how they would treat me after a service? Or let alone my puppy? She couldn’t even grab a supervisor for me at all. I’m not even sure if this place knows how rude their staff can be to their new clients when no one else is around. Because mind you, there was no one else there at the time of my attempt to check in except for an older lady. Do better, there’s already enough hate in the world for people to spread it anywhere.
Sarah is not only the best vet tech I've ever met, but also the best person! I loved the vet, too. Everyone is super nice and were able to answer all my questions.

I brought in a stray cat and somehow VCA missed that she was so pregnant that she started giving birth to kittens on my lawn the next morning. If they had given me any indication that she may have been pregnant, I would have done so much more for her in that moment. From the patient room while they had her back with them for examination, I overheard the doctors/techs talking about a critical patient who needed to be euthanized - I thought they meant the girl I brought in. It appears they were just busy with another cat and now I wonder how that played a factor in their oversight. SPCA came to pick them up and told me they'll all probably not make it. Please seek other doctors before taking your babies here. My cat will definitely not be going back there.

Terrible service—though they are certainly good at collecting payments. Despite everything I told them about my dog's symptoms, they failed to identify that she had Parvo. Instead, they opted to perform an ultrasound and administer probiotics—even after I explained that she couldn't even keep water down because she was vomiting everything up. They sent us home and told me to bring her back only if her condition worsened. I paid $557.97 for this service, only for her to get even sicker. I didn't go back to them; instead, I went to another clinic where the service is both better and more affordable. Thank God—and thanks to the veterinarians at PetCare Holcombe—my dog ​​was saved from Parvo. Please, do not take your pets to this clinic.
Check other places, don't bring your pet here, I did and regret it.

Hey Cassandra, thanks so much for taking the time to share your feedback! We're so glad to have you as part of the VCA Spring Branch family, and if you ever need anything, please feel free to reach out to us at VCAContactUs@vca.com. 🐾 …

This place is extremely overpriced. Other clinics within a few minutes from here are literally half the price. Feeling pretty stupid right now that I just paid $205 for an exam and eye stein check. Just learned it costs $100 at another clinic 5 min up the road. I’ll never come back!

Horrible service, 600 dollars for the vet to say “she’s fine” when she had parvo, plus the saying of “if she doesn’t get better you can bring her back” we took her to another clinic and they said she had parvo. And they said that if the clinic had given her treatment the day we took her that the parvo wouldn’t have advanced so quickly
Joshua, thank you so much for the kind words! We're so grateful to have you as part of the VCA Spring Branch family. If you ever need anything, please reach out at VCAContactUs@vca.com. 💙🐾 …
Lexi was very kind and helpful. She was very gentle with my cat and I appreciate that so much. definitely recommend, thank you so much
Doctor was genuine and cared for pet.. as im a first time pet owner and she addressed all our concern.
Their service was well done and not welcoming at all and they only cared for the money not about my pet and was not professional at all def do not  recommend this vet

I would never recommend this clinic. From the start, they were inconsiderate and failed to clearly communicate the service they could provide for the severity of my cat’s condition. While the vets initially explained things in a way that sounded logical, as soon as they left the room I could hear vets and techs laughing and snickering about having “missed that lesson during COVID.” That “lesson” turned out to be something critical: placing a catheter.
They rushed me into making a decision that involved paying thousands of dollars, told me everything was fine, and said I could leave and just pick my cat up before closing. Thirty minutes later, they called to say they couldn’t do anything more for him and that I should seek treatment elsewhere.
Despite knowing they couldn’t provide the necessary care, they continued attempting the procedure anyway. Multiple staff members tried repeatedly, prolonging the time my cat remained blocked. As a result, urine began leaking from his bladder into his organs, worsening his condition.
When I took my cat to a second clinic, they placed the catheter with ease and said there should never have been an issue.
This clinic was unprofessional, careless, and lacked the competence to provide proper care. My cat suffered because of it.
Thank you so much, Ken!
Megan, thank you for taking the time to share this feedback and 5-star review! 💙 🐾  …

Fantastic experience! They took wonderful care of my cat. We called about a tooth extraction, were clearly given our options, and felt confident moving forward. The procedure went smoothly, and I truly appreciate the compassion and professionalism shown throughout. Thank you! we will be back soon
They are so great with our kitties!
Great facility and great staff.

Love this place. Have taken all my pets here but recently everytime I call there’s a lady that has the worst attitude. I called Thursday 11/13 at 3:46pm. She’s never helpful and I’ve been meaning to ask for her name.

My experience with this veterinary hospital was mixed. While the veterinarian who cared for my pets spoke kindly and seemed knowledgeable, I found the overall pricing structure to be excessively high. The profit margin appears extreme, and I felt there was a strong emphasis on upselling additional services during the visit.

It’s unfortunate because it gives the impression that staff are encouraged to push unnecessary extras, which can make an already emotional situation even more stressful for pet owners. I truly wish this weren’t the case, as I value good veterinary care — but I cannot comfortably recommend this hospital based on my experience. I believe pet owners deserve honest care without feeling pressured to overspend during a vulnerable time.
Will come back

The receptionist at the front desk was discourteous and dismissive. I was informed that I must bring my dog in every month for heartworm and flea medication because they do not trust me to report her weight accurately. I have brought my puppy here several times for vaccinations, and each visit has been with a different veterinarian. This inconsistency and lack of personal rapport make it difficult to feel confident in the level of care and professionalism provided.
Linda we appreciate the positive review! 💙 🐾  …
Offer too many quotes without full diagnostics. Statistical advertisements not backed by evidence. Quoted me over 800 for a cat with a cough….
Hi Tue! We’re sorry your visit didn’t meet expectations. Please DM us or call 713-461-1121, so we can learn more and make things right. Your feedback matters!

A number of years ago I took my pet beagle to this vet, he was getting up in age and suddenly developed some sort of bizarre spasms. We freaked out and rushed him to this vet which was open and accepting new pup patients (his usual vet in Louisiana was too far). They did a bunch of tests, $800 worth - and came back and said it was probably best to put him down based on his current condition. I absolutely couldn't do it, and wouldn't be pressured on the spot for such an important decision. Took him home and a few hours later he snapped out of it. Turns out it was the dog version of vertigo. He had it a few more times over the course of the ensuing years, but he stuck with us for a few more years. They charged a lot of money for simple tests, freaked us out as you have no idea what's happening with your pet when they take him in the back, and ultimately gave TERRIBLE advice on what to do - recommending to put him down. I wouldn't take my worst enemy to this location.
Thank you so much for your review, Jennette! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch Animal Hospital —your feedback means a lot to us! 💙 …
Thank you so much for your review, Anthony! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch Animal Hospital—your feedback means a lot to us! 💙 …

About 15-20 years ago I used this place for my dog and was pleased with it at the time. That was the reason I chose to use them with my current dog over the last 2 years even though I no longer live as close as I once did. However, after my last visit in Sept 2024, I found i would no longer be able to use them due to their high costs. They charged me $307.65 just for a regular annual exam with vaccines. I brought the fecal sample in myself, but they didn't even run the heart worm test on it because they were going to charge another couple of hundred dollars and I did not have $600+ to pay for the visit. They then proceeded to give me a hard time about filling my dog's heart worm prescriptions for the following year. I just took my dog for this year's annual exam at a new veterinary's office. They too had to give her vaccines. They also did the heart worm test and extracted the fecal matter themselves, and let me tell you my dog was being a bit difficult. They also did a blood test which I don't recall them doing at VCA last year, and guess what? The new vet only charged $164.75 for EVERYTHING. They were very friendly and showed much concern for my dog as well. Never going back to VCA now. They need to really come down on those prices as they are really ridiculous.

The doctors have obviously become salesmen, I take my cat in for a small issue and they try to upsell me on subscription medication, unnecessary vaccinations. It sucks that I can no longer trust them to have my pets best interest in mind over profits.

Very bad experience, I would never recommend this place. I brought my pet to his annual wellness exam. He was completely fine and eating well. They prescribed a treatment for his behavior. He stopped eating on the first day of taking the medication. I informed them. The doctor told me to wait 2 or 3 days. After insisting, I told her to prescribe something for him to eat. Her response was to do a series of tests at my own expense. In summary, they make your pet sick so that you later have to spend money and recover the first free wellness exam that they offer. It is easy for them. Now I have to look for a better place to take my pet and make sure that his organs are okay and that the medication did not harm him.

This was my first visit to the vet with my dog. The vet tech and doctor were both very kind and professional — they made me and my dog feel comfortable, and I appreciated the care they gave us.
I was there to pick up medicine, and while the process itself was smooth, the experience at the front desk wasn’t great. The receptionist seemed a bit aggressive and didn’t greet me or ask how they could help when I approached. It felt unwelcoming, especially as a first-time visitor.
I hope this is something that can be improved, because the rest of the staff was wonderful and I’d like to continue coming here with my dog.
Thank you so much for your review, Katie! We’d love to hear more about your experience, your feedback means a lot to us!

They are always great. Very kind.
We lost our old dog Oscar to an aged dog neurological disease.
He lived a good life and it broke our hearts to let him go. It was the first time we had to go through it and when we did this team helped us, comforted us and went way above and beyond in their support to help us keep it calm, peaceful and intimate. Such good people.
After some time we adopted another dog from a local shelter and we KNEW that VCA would be our Veterinary team to care for Luna. It's a little far from our home but we wouldn't go anywhere else. Great place, great people.
Thank you so much for your review, Nelly! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch Animal Hospital, your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …
I like this place but the receptionists always seem passive aggressive.
Our fur baby doctors for yesrs!
Thank you so much for your review, Nicole! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch Animal Hospital, your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …

We took our dog and cat here to Dr. McConaughey for their entire 11-12 years of life. These folks are amazing, I highly recommend them.

Through regular checkups, every illness and even when we had to say goodbye to our fur-babies at the end of their lives, VCA Spring Branch was there every step of the way.

This place is such a rip off! They charged over $100 for a benadryl shot, that I couldn't even see them inject my pet. I dont even know if they actually gave him the shot. They took him to the back! Never in my life did a vet have to take my dog to the back to get a shot. They do in front of me. Also the swelling never went down after the shot! I had to get my puppy kids benadryl drops for the swelling to go down. I called brittmoore animal hospital vet and the most they charge for a benadryl shot is $20-$50! Please do not take your pet here! They lie and overcharge!

Dr. Stone took excellent care of our dog. Originally we went in for a tooth extraction, and after an exam Dr. Stone found it was something completely different. She made sure to cover everything and get us on the proper treatment plan. She has been steps ahead of everything. She’s awesome and we absolutely love Dr. Stone.

Staff is great! They are very attentive and helpful in going over any medical or care concerns. The staff is very caring and nurturing to our fur babies which is a huge relief to see them love on them just as much as we do!
Great staff and doctors. My dog can be a handful but they always find a way for her to settle and always take great care of her
I heard the staff yell at the animals.  Totally unacceptable!
They yell and mistreat the animals here. My girlfriend lives in the apartments behind this place and we hear and see alot. Dont leave your dogs here
Thank you so much for your review, Phillip! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch Animal Hospital—your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …

This place is a joke. They DO NOT CARE about your pet. The only thing important to this place is your money.
They charged me 203.00 for a toe nail trim and an antibiotic.They suggested an antibiotic that was 80.00 and I said I didn't have the money right now for the antibiotic and could she please give my dog amoxicillin instead. She said that's fine and would call it in to Walmart. So I go to Walmart first thing the next morning and NO ANTIBIOTIC. So I called the office to find out why the antibiotic was
not there. They told me that since I didn't take the antibiotic they recommended that they wouldn't call in the amoxicillin the doctor and I had agreed on
We've had dogs our entire lives and I HAVE NEVER SEEN such a heartless veterinarian !!
Please go to an independent veterinarian and stay away from this place.

They sat and took time to go over everything with me and waited for me to get info from the breeder so they could make sound decisions for my pup and I could just tell they cared. I was skeptical about the free exam because nothing usually is ever free, but it actually was and came at a time when I really needed it; me and my babes will be customers for as long as we’re in the Houston area! I also witnessed some amazing customer service for an owner that say the wrong appointment and she was accommodated without hesitation. Nice place from front to back!
Thank you so much for your review, Clyde! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch Animal Hospital—your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …
Thank you so much for your review, Kourtney! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Spring Branch - your feedback means a lot to us! 💜  …

My dog had a swollen neck, and her hair was coming out in clumps. I had a prior awful experience at Neartown vet in Houston, so I called VCA on the recommendation of my neighbors.  They got my girl in the same day and were able to get her the meds she needed.  The bill wasn't nearly as much as Neartown vet, and the service was way better.  I felt like they were concerned about my dog and not about finding reasons to charge me.  They didn't try to sell me unnecessary services and just gave me what she needed.   I appreciate the honesty.  They will be my new go-to vet.
They’re always very patient and kind with my furbaby.
Great service

Dr Randall and the staff are amazing. My dog Tucker is spooked by glass doors and we walked him to the back where he would enter a normal door, into an exam room. Extremely patient. Even got on the floor to examine him. Won't go anywhere else.
Great experience, the staff was very kind. Especially CJ, he took care of my older dog. Clean and well run facility.

Everyone was kind. The Dr was explained herself thoroughly and patiently. The techs were all sweet to our cats and took car when vaccinating our feisty kitty. They got is right in when our ferral friend showed up. Highly recommend

Somebody called me for more information and on the last question i didn’t understand it. She got anger and said okay see you tomorrow shut the phone off. It was so rude and i don’t think go there. You guys can be nice and friendly. No need to get rude.

Love the crew at VCA long point!!

We've been using them for over 20 years for our very needy and high-maintenance English Bulldogs.
Always friendly.  Knowledgeable staff. Treat my fur babies very well.

FRONT DESK WAS EXTREMELY RUDE WHEN ANSWERING THE PHONE AND QUESTIONS. SHE WAS NOT HELPFUL AND DID NOT OFFER PROPER INFORMATION REGARDING THE REASONS OF MY CALL. SHE WAS COMPLETELY INSENSITIVE AND WAS UNPOLITE.
Very knowledgeable and professional.

Had an appointment for 5 o’clock and told them i was running 20 mins late due to traffic, the girl at the front desk told me that was fine she NEVER said anything about the doctor leaving at 6. I get there and i’m told the doctors leaves at 6 she can’t see my pet and so i let them know that i spoke to someone otp and that was never mentioned because if it was i never would’ve went. Very dumb & unprofessional that should’ve been mentioned when i called instead of telling me that it was fine for us to come. Would give zero stars for the inconvenience if i could.

Front desk staff is great and so are the techs. The physician taking care of us had very poor bedside manner. She was in a rush clearly, and gave us a terminal diagnosis for our kitty. pretty much told us we can take her home, hope for the best and likely have to euthanize her. We took her to another practice for a second opinion, and she’s now doing great. Would have just appreciated some more compassion as we were totally devastated and taken aback by this diagnosis.
Clean and fantastic care AND minimal wait time.  Been taking out doggos here for routine care for almost 20 years!
Don’t take birds even if the ASPCA gives you a certificate to take bird to the vet there for check up after an adoption.

Great attention to detail
Felt cared for

Needed a new patient appointment for ferret, they got me in Same Day! Showed up and was back at the room quickly, everyone adored my pet the same way that I do. Dr. Grana and her staff are fabulous!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This place used to be good.
Made 2 appointments for my 2 dogs; they had to space it 30 mins apart on their official booking, but the dogs were both seen at the same time when we finally got called in.
We waited MORE THAN AN HOUR past the first appointment time before they even called us in.  It was frustrating.  What’s the point of setting up an appointment when they can’t even keep the appointment time on track?!

The vet tech came in to weight our dogs and asked for our concerns, which we didn’t really have anything since we were just wanting to bring them in to do a normal check up.  We then left alone waiting in that room fooooorrreeeeverrrrr until Dr. Bernadette Guirguis came in.  She spent no longer than 2 minutes examining each of my dogs.  I’m not exaggerating.  And for that, we paid $101 for each dog for the 2 minute she gave.  She didn’t even notice dental problem I had noticed on one of my dogs had I not bring it up.  I’m considering taking my dogs elsewhere since it seems she’s doing things at bare minimum.

Not impressed.

Eveytime I have to call for help I'm placed on hold! Everytime!! My dog's Comboguard medicine didn't arrive. I've been calling for a week to get int touch with someone. But I can't get in touch with anyone. Then when I try to leave a message their automated system automatically ends the call before I can leave a message. This is ridiculous! I am.cutrentkt looking for another vet place to take my dog.
They are too chaotic and disorganized and the prices are outrageous.

This VCA Spring Branch location off Gessner & Long point is my Vet where I take my cat for regular exams year round. They are closed Sundays, but have great welcoming staff & experienced Vet Drs.the rest of the week.,who are very caring for your pets.
All the doctors and staff here are fantastic, especially Dr Clemmensen. Highly recommend.

Doctor took care of our sick senior dog quickly and efficiently. I had my thoughts on what was wrong with our dog and second guessed the doctors instructions. She did a complimentary check to disprove my theory and then diagnosed the dog and treated her accordingly. Pricing was fair and care was top notch.
